description.p: Hold Right Alt, speak, and release: Talkies transcribes your speech locally with Whisper and types the text into the app you are using. Nothing leaves your computer.

ul.li: Push-to-talk or tap-to-toggle hotkey on X11 and Wayland
Optional cleanup with the bundled S1-mini model, Ollama, or LM Studio
Floating dictation indicator and a system tray item
Restores your clipboard after inserting text
